title.en: A stone zemí and Taíno ceremonial authority
title.zh: 石制泽米与泰诺仪式权威

alt.en: A tan stone figure with large hollow eyes, thin limbs and a flat-topped form above its head.
alt.zh: 黄褐色石像有大型凹眼、细瘦四肢，头顶上方呈平顶形。

caption.en: Taíno zemí figure, 1200–1500 CE; biocalcarenite stone, Met 1979.206.1209. The catalog tentatively locates it in the present-day Dominican Republic.
caption.zh: 泰诺泽米像，1200—1500年；生物碎屑灰岩，大都会1979.206.1209。馆录暂将其来源定位于今多米尼加共和国。

interpretation.en: The museum interprets this figure as probably supporting ceremonial cohoba. Zemí denotes spiritual or vital force associated with deities and ancestors, rather than simply the carved object.
interpretation.zh: 博物馆认为此像可能用于承托仪式中的科霍巴。泽米指与神祇和祖先相关的精神或生命力量，并非仅指雕刻物本身。

items.creator: Taíno artist(s)
items.credit: The Michael C. Rockefeller Memorial Collection, Bequest of Nelson A. Rockefeller, 1979

title.en: A miniature camelid links herding and ceremony
title.zh: 骆驼科动物小像连接畜牧与仪式

alt.en: A small metal camelid stands on four legs with an upright neck, two long ears and a curved tail.
alt.zh: 金属骆驼科动物小像四足站立，颈部直立，有两只长耳与弯曲尾巴。

caption.en: Inca miniature camelid effigy, 1400–1535 CE; silver, gold and copper alloy, Met 1974.271.36.
caption.zh: 印加骆驼科动物小像，1400—1535年；银、金与铜合金，大都会1974.271.36。

interpretation.en: The Met identifies a male camelid, possibly a llama. The figure brings the importance of herds into focus without documenting any particular farm or ritual deposit.
interpretation.zh: 大都会识别其为雄性骆驼科动物，可能是美洲驼。小像使畜群的重要性更加具体，但并不记录某个特定农场或仪式埋藏。

title.en: A Kuba whistle turns carving into sound
title.zh: 库巴哨把雕刻化为声音

alt.en: A dark wooden whistle has a small carved human head on a long tapering neck and a broad lower body.
alt.zh: 深色木哨在修长渐细的颈部上雕有小人头，下部器身宽阔。

caption.en: Kuba wooden whistle, mid-nineteenth century, present-day Democratic Republic of the Congo; Met 2006.390.
caption.zh: 库巴木哨，十九世纪中叶，今刚果民主共和国；大都会2006.390。

interpretation.en: This is a sound-producing object as well as a carved figure. The museum discusses signaling and ensemble performance as uses of African whistles, but does not document the particular use of this specimen.
interpretation.zh: 它既是雕刻形象，也是发声器。馆方讨论非洲哨器的传信和合奏用途，但未记录这件实物的具体使用经历。

note.en: Official item page marks the image Public Domain; the saved API record confirms isPublicDomain=true.
note.zh: 官方单件页面标注图像为公共领域；所存API记录确认isPublicDomain=true。

alt.en: A reddish terracotta figure sits with folded legs, arms around a raised knee and its head tilted down against it.
alt.zh: 红褐色陶塑盘腿而坐，双臂环抱抬起的膝部，头部低垂倚靠其上。

caption.en: Seated figure by a Middle Niger artist, thirteenth century; terracotta, Met 1981.218. The museum attributes its origin to Djenné-Djeno.
caption.zh: 尼日尔河中游匠人的坐像，十三世纪；陶土，大都会1981.218。馆方将其来源归于杰内杰诺。

interpretation.en: The compact pose and modeled surface preserve the work of a sculptor within an urban material culture. Its original significance remains uncertain; the pose alone cannot identify illness, prayer or a named person.
interpretation.zh: 紧凑姿态与塑造表面保存了城市物质文化中雕塑者的劳动。其原始意义仍不明确，不能仅凭姿势认定疾病、祈祷或某位具名人物。
